g.text: NEW N+1 in blog-api › request handler - /tags/n1: insert repeated up to 8× (1 trace, 61.9 ms total, ~36.8 ms avoidable)
query: select "public"."tag"."id" from "public"."tag" where ("public"."tag"."name" = ? and ? = ?) offset ?

NEW N+1 in blog-api › request handler - /export: select repeated up to 8× (1 trace, 19.8 ms total, ~15.7 ms avoidable)
"public"."post"."createdat" from "public"."post" where "public"."post"."id" > ? order by "public"."post"."id" asc limit ? offset ?
fix: Load the related rows in one query: use `include`/`select` on the parent query, or collect the keys and call
`findMany({ where: { id: { in: keys } } })` once, then join in memory.
